ds06.title: What Every Body Fat Percentage Looks Like
ds06.hook: This is what every body fat percentage actually looks like on a man.
ds06.body: At 30 percent your stomach is round and your face is full. At 25 you still have a gut. At 20 you look fine in a shirt. At 15 the top two abs show. At 10 you have a full six pack, a jawline and veins in your arms. Almost every man is one full category fatter than he thinks, and most guys bulking would be better off cutting.
ds06.close: Focus only on losing fat until you get to 10 percent with ripped abs. You'll thank me once you do.
ds06.points:
30% body fat: round stomach, full face, soft chest.
25%: you still have a gut.
20%: flat enough to look fine in a shirt.
15%: the top two abs show.
10%: a full six pack, a jawline and veins in your arms.
ds06.pinned: Most guys are one full category fatter than they think. Be honest, what body fat percentage do you think you're at right now?

ds10.title: Top 3 Non-Weight Loss Benefits Of Zepbound
ds10.hook: Here are three unexpected ways Zepbound made my life better beyond just helping me get lean.
ds10.body: First, it cut my drinking. I did not decide to quit. The wanting just left. Second, I got way more productive at work, because it quiets the food noise and makes it easier to fast while I work. Third, my sleep got dramatically better because I finally stopped eating late at night.
ds10.close: If you're carrying a lot of belly fat, go talk to a doctor about Zepbound instead of white-knuckling another diet.
ds10.points:
1. I drink way less alcohol.
2. I'm more productive at work.
3. My sleep got dramatically better.
ds10.pinned: Cutting back on drinking, getting more done at work, or sleeping better because you stopped eating late at night. Which one of those three would you want most?

ds13.title: The #1 Change I Made To Get Abs At 40
ds13.hook: The number one change I made to get six pack abs at 40 was not a workout.
ds13.body: I threw out every carb snack in my house. My meals were clean and I still wasn't lean, because of the chips, the crackers and even the healthy trail mix. I swapped all of it for protein and fat: hard boiled eggs, sardines and chipotle protein cups. Protein and fat fill you up, you hit your protein without trying, and after about three weeks you stop wanting the carb snacks at all.
ds13.close: Don't change your meals this week. Just change your snacks, then comment and let me know how switching to protein snacks works for you.
ds13.points:
Throw out every carb snack in your house.
Swap them for protein and fat: hard boiled eggs, sardines, chipotle protein cups.
After about three weeks the carb cravings are gone.
ds13.pinned: I threw out every carb snack and switched to hard boiled eggs, sardines and chipotle protein cups. What's your go-to snack right now?
